description: Industry-grade stable API for flights AND hotels with multi-product cart booking — search flights and hotels, build one trip containing both, and check out via a Jinko-hosted Stripe page from the terminal.
auth_description: Get an API key at https://app.gojinko.com/devplatform, then run `jinko auth login --key jnk_...` or export JINKO_API_KEY. The same credential works with @gojinko/cli (Node) and Jinko's MCP server.

novel_features.name: Multi-product trip in one cart
novel_features.description: A single trip_id accepts both flight and hotel trip_item_tokens. `book` checks out the whole cart with one Stripe payment URL — every other travel CLI in this library books only flights OR only hotels.

novel_features.name: Agent-friendly token flow
novel_features.description: Named tokens that compose: offer_token (cached) → trip_item_token (live, bookable) → trip_id (cart) → checkout_url (Stripe). No hidden state, no implicit quote step — quote is automatic inside book.

novel_features.name: Hotel + flight live inventory
novel_features.description: Live rates from Jinko's supplier network (Sabre, Travelfusion, Nuitee, and more). Stable, contracted API — not scraped or cookie-jacked. Industry-grade SLA on the BFF.

novel_features.name: End-to-end lifecycle polling
novel_features.description: One endpoint returns cart, quote, payment, fulfillment, and PNRs. Designed for long-running async bookings (TravelFusion confirmations can take up to 72h) — agents poll this to know when to send the confirmation email.
